the work of the apana air

meaning.en: external thought should not be done

meaning.en: be established in pure consciousness alone

meaning.en: the knowable and all that is perceived

meaning.hi: बिना थकान वाले दृढ़ अभ्यास से

meaning.en: and through the practice of solitary meditation
the vibration of mind is restrained
by deeply experiencing the sound at the end of chanting Om
meaning.hi: ॐ-उच्चारण के अंत की ध्वनि के तत्त्व के अनुभव से

meaning.en: when deep sleep is known by awareness
meaning.hi: गहरी नींद के चेतना से जाने जाने पर

meaning.en: the vibration of prana is restrained
the little bell at the root of the palate
meaning.hi: तालु की जड़ की घंटी को

meaning.en: pressing it with the tongue through effort

meaning.hi: प्राण के ऊपर के छिद्र में जाने पर

meaning.en: the vibration of prana is restrained
when prana has its awareness melted
meaning.hi: प्राण की चेतना के घुल जाने पर

meaning.en: gone above the palate to the point twelve fingers beyond
meaning.hi: तालु के ऊपर द्वादशांत तक गए

meaning.en: through practice by the upper opening
meaning.hi: अभ्यास से ऊपर के छिद्र द्वारा

meaning.en: the vibration of prana is restrained
in the clear space at the tip of the nose
meaning.hi: नाक की नोक के निर्मल आकाश में

meaning.en: when the eye of awareness becomes calm
meaning.hi: चेतना की दृष्टि के शांत होने पर

meaning.en: the vibration of prana is restrained
when the light of the pupils is calmed
meaning.hi: पुतलियों के प्रकाश के शांत होने पर

meaning.en: when it has reached its end
when bound to the single thread of awareness
meaning.hi: चेतना के एक धागे से बँधने पर

meaning.en: the vibration of prana is restrained
that which has arisen simply as Om
meaning.hi: जो केवल ॐ रूप में उत्पन्न हुआ

meaning.en: auspicious knowledge one with the known

through long experience of the solitary space of the heart
meaning.hi: हृदय के एकांत आकाश के लंबे अनुभव से

meaning.en: through meditation of a mind free of lingering impressions
the vibration of prana is restrained
found in the mouths of various teachers
meaning.hi: अनेक गुरुओं के मुख में स्थित

meaning.en: the vibration of prana is restrained
should break open the door of liberation
the path by which one must go
covering that door with her mouth
meaning.hi: उस द्वार को मुँह से ढककर

meaning.en: lies crooked, coiled like a serpent
meaning.hi: टेढ़ी, साँप की तरह लिपटी रहती है

meaning.en: by whom that power is set moving
meaning.hi: जिसके द्वारा वह शक्ति चलाई जाए

meaning.en: if she sleeps in the region above the throat
meaning.hi: अगर गले के ऊपर के भाग में सोई हो

meaning.en: she is for the liberation of yogis
meaning.hi: योगियों की मुक्ति के लिए होती है

meaning.en: below, for the bondage of the deluded
meaning.hi: नीचे, मूढ़ों के बंधन के लिए

meaning.en: abandoning the two paths beginning with Ida
meaning.hi: इडा आदि दोनों मार्गों को छोड़कर

meaning.en: should go by the path of Sushumna
that is the supreme abode of Vishnu
meaning.hi: वह विष्णु का परम पद है

meaning.en: should be practised joined with the mind
the mind's activity, by the wise
one should not worship Vishnu by day
meaning.hi: दिन में विष्णु की पूजा न करे

meaning.en: not worship by day and night
situated in the left and right channels
the air moves in the middle
should swallow the air in the void
between the moon and the sun
meaning.hi: चंद्र और सूर्य दोनों के बीच

meaning.en: she is established in the wheel of the sky

meaning.hi: वह मुद्रा खेचरी नाम की है

meaning.en: having made the tongue extend beyond
fixing the gaze between the eyebrows
into the hollow of the skull
when the tongue goes turned back
by that, the person with upturned tongue
meaning.hi: उससे ऊपर मुड़ी जीभ वाला पुरुष

meaning.en: pressing the perineum with the root of the left foot
meaning.hi: बाएँ पैर की जड़ से योनि-स्थान दबाकर

meaning.en: by that, removal of all afflictions
wasting disease, abdominal lumps, bowel disorders
skin ailments of age and other faults are destroyed
meaning.hi: पुरानी त्वचा आदि के दोष नष्ट होते हैं

meaning.en: this is the means of conquering prana
placing the left heel at the perineum
meaning.hi: बाईं एड़ी को योनि-स्थान पर लगाकर

meaning.en: setting the right foot on the left thigh
meaning.hi: दाहिना पैर बाईं जाँघ पर रखकर

meaning.en: placing the chin on the chest
holding it within the mind as far as one can
drawing the breath in from outside
having filled it so that it rests in the belly
at the middle of the navel and the tip of the nose
meaning.hi: नाभि के बीच और नाक की नोक पर

meaning.en: and at the big toe, with effort
meaning.hi: और पैर के अँगूठे पर, यत्न से

meaning.en: should hold the breath with the mind
at the junctions of the day, or always
the yogi becomes free of fatigue
at the nose tip there is victory over the air
meaning.hi: नाक की नोक पर वायु-विजय होती है

meaning.en: at the navel, destruction of all disease
meaning.hi: नाभि के बीच सब रोगों का नाश

meaning.en: holding at the big toe brings lightness of body
meaning.hi: अँगूठे पर धारण से शरीर का हल्कापन

meaning.en: drawing air in through the tongue
the person who drinks it constantly
a brahmin at the time of the two junctions
who draws in the air and drinks it

meaning.hi: मंगलमयी वाणी सरस्वती उत्पन्न होती है

meaning.en: thus, by six months of practice
meaning.hi: इस तरह छह महीने के अभ्यास से

meaning.en: bringing in air with the tongue
should hold it at the root of the tongue
the wise one who drinks the nectar
breaking through to the food of the gods
even one afflicted by disease is freed
meaning.hi: रोगी भी मुक्त हो जाता है

meaning.en: raising the air through the two channels
at the navel and the two sides of the belly
meaning.hi: नाभि और पेट के दोनों बगलों में

meaning.en: whoever sustains it for one ghatika
meaning.hi: जो एक घटिका तक धारण करे
वह रोगों से मुक्त होता है

meaning.en: for one month at the three junctions
meaning.hi: एक महीने तक तीनों संधियों में

meaning.en: raising the air with the tongue
piercing through to the food of the gods
should hold it in the middle of the belly
meaning.hi: पेट के बीच में धारण करे

meaning.en: whoever daily, even for a short while
at the nose tip together with the mind
meaning.hi: नाक की नोक पर मन के साथ
सारे पाप को पार करता है

meaning.en: his, gathered over a hundred births
through focused absorption on the star

meaning.hi: सब विषयों का ज्ञान होता है

meaning.en: through absorption of the mind on the nose tip
meaning.hi: नाक की नोक पर चित्त-संयम से

meaning.en: through absorption of the mind below that
through absorption of the mind on the eye
through absorption of the mind on the ear
meaning.hi: कान पर चित्त के संयम से

meaning.en: through absorption on the left ear
through absorption on the left eye
through absorption on the underside of the foot
meaning.hi: पैर के निचले भाग पर संयम से

meaning.en: through absorption on the ankle joint
meaning.hi: टखने के जोड़ पर संयम से

meaning.en: through absorption of the mind on the thigh
through absorption of the mind on the hips
through absorption of the mind on the navel
knowledge of the middle world of the sky
through absorption of the mind on the heart
meaning.hi: हृदय पर चित्त के संयम से

meaning.en: through absorption of the mind above the heart
meaning.hi: हृदय के ऊपरी भाग पर चित्त-संयम से

meaning.en: through absorption of the mind on the throat
through absorption of the mind between the eyebrows
through absorption of the mind on the crown
through absorption on right and wrong action
through absorption of the mind on each creature's sound
meaning.hi: हर प्राणी की ध्वनि पर चित्त-संयम से

meaning.en: knowledge of the cries of all creatures
meaning.hi: सब प्राणियों की बोली का ज्ञान

meaning.en: through absorption of the mind on stored karma
through absorption of the mind on another's mind
meaning.hi: दूसरे के चित्त पर चित्त-संयम से

meaning.en: through absorption of the mind on the body's form
meaning.hi: शरीर के रूप पर चित्त-संयम से

meaning.en: through absorption of the mind on strength
strength like that of Hanuman and others
through absorption of the mind on the sun
through absorption of the mind on the moon
knowledge of the arrangement of the stars
through absorption on what exists for its own sake
on the hollow of the throat
through absorption on the space within the body
meaning.hi: शरीर के आकाश पर संयम से

meaning.en: through absorption on each respective place
of the senses wandering among objects
as the Self (commonly read as ātmā iti)
big toe, ankle, shin, knee, thigh
by ascending and descending in sequence
holding the mind on the Self
meaning.hi: आत्मा में मन को धारण करना

meaning.en: holding outer space in the small space of the heart
meaning.hi: हृदय के सूक्ष्म आकाश में बाहरी आकाश को धारण करना

meaning.en: in earth, water, fire, air and space
meaning.hi: पृथ्वी, जल, अग्नि, वायु और आकाश में

meaning.en: meditation with qualities is on a form
meditation without qualities is on the Self as it is
meaning.hi: निर्गुण आत्मा के यथार्थ स्वरूप का

meaning.en: the state of oneness of the individual and supreme Self
free from the triad of knower, knowing and known
is of the nature of pure consciousness
then Shandilya, a sage of the highest rank
not finding the knowledge of Brahman in the four Vedas
meaning.hi: चारों वेदों में ब्रह्म-विद्या न पाते हुए

meaning.en: teach me, lord, the knowledge of Brahman
by which I shall attain the highest good
Brahman is truth, knowledge and the infinite
meaning.hi: ब्रह्म सत्य, विज्ञान और अनंत है

words.sanskrit: यस्मिन् इदं सं च वि च एति सर्वम्

meaning.en: in which all this comes together and disperses
meaning.hi: जिसमें यह सब मिलता और बिखरता है
यह सब जाना हुआ हो जाता है

meaning.en: that is without hands and feet

meaning.hi: बिना आँख, कान और जीभ का
न पकड़ में आने वाला, न बताया जा सकने वाला
जहाँ से वाणी लौट आती है

meaning.en: not reaching it, together with the mind
meaning.hi: मन के साथ उसे पाए बिना

meaning.en: which is attainable by knowledge alone
meaning.hi: जो केवल ज्ञान से प्राप्य है

meaning.en: and from which the ancient wisdom flowed forth
which is one without a second
one essence of consciousness and bliss, auspicious, peaceful, immortal
meaning.hi: चित्-आनंद का एक रस, मंगलमय, शांत, अमर

meaning.en: the one God whose power is his own self
all-knowing, lord of all, inner self of all beings
meaning.hi: सर्वज्ञ, सर्वेश्वर, सब प्राणियों की अंतरात्मा

meaning.en: source of beings, reached only by yoga
meaning.hi: प्राणियों का स्रोत, केवल योग से प्राप्य

words.sanskrit: यः विश्वं सृजति बिभर्ति भुङ्क्ते सः आत्मा

meaning.en: he who creates, sustains and enjoys the universe is the Self
meaning.hi: जो विश्व को रचता, धारता, भोगता है, वह आत्मा है

meaning.en: the knower of the Self will reach the end of sorrow
meaning.hi: आत्मज्ञानी शोक के अंत तक पहुँचेगा
तब शाण्डिल्य ने अथर्वा से पूछा

words.sanskrit: यत् एकम् अक्षरं निष्क्रियं शिवं सन्मात्रं परंब्रह्म

meaning.en: the supreme Brahman, one, imperishable, actionless, auspicious, pure being
meaning.hi: जो एक, अक्षर, निष्क्रिय, शिव, सन्मात्र परब्रह्म है

meaning.en: how is this universe born from it
meaning.hi: उससे यह विश्व कैसे जन्मता है

meaning.en: how does it dissolve into it
you are able to cut this doubt of mine
meaning.hi: मेरा यह संशय काटने में आप समर्थ हैं

meaning.en: that the supreme Brahman is actionless and imperishable
meaning.hi: कि परब्रह्म निष्क्रिय और अक्षर है
फिर भी इस अरूप ब्रह्म के

meaning.en: with parts, without parts, and both
that is the form without parts

words.sanskrit: अथ अस्य या सहजा अस्ति अविद्या

meaning.en: now, the ignorance that is innate in it
meaning.hi: अब उसकी जो सहज अविद्या है

meaning.en: the God with her as his helper
dark and tawny, my Lord, rules
meaning.hi: साँवला-पिंगल, मेरा ईश्वर, शासन करता है

meaning.en: this is its form both with and without parts
then he, growing full through austerity made of knowledge
meaning.hi: तब वह ज्ञानमय तप से बढ़ता हुआ

meaning.en: desired: may I be many, may I be born
meaning.hi: चाहा: मैं बहुत हो जाऊँ, जन्म लूँ

meaning.en: from him glowing with austerity, whose desire is true
three sacred utterances, the three-footed Gayatri

words.sanskrit: त्रयः वर्णाः त्रयः अग्नयः च जायन्ते

meaning.en: three classes and three fires are born
meaning.hi: तीन वर्ण और तीन अग्नियाँ उत्पन्न होते हैं

meaning.en: seated in the hearts of all beings
meaning.hi: सब प्राणियों के हृदय में स्थित

meaning.en: the master of maya plays through maya

words.sanskrit: सः ब्रह्मा सः विष्णुः सः रुद्रः सः इन्द्रः

meaning.en: he is Brahma, Vishnu, Rudra, Indra
meaning.hi: वही ब्रह्मा, विष्णु, रुद्र, इंद्र है

meaning.en: compassionate to devotees, in the form of Dattatreya
meaning.hi: भक्तों पर करुणा करने वाले का दत्तात्रेय रूप

meaning.en: like a blue lotus petal, four-armed
this is his form with parts
Lord, pure being, the single essence of consciousness and bliss
why is it called the supreme Brahman
meaning.hi: परम ब्रह्म क्यों कहा जाता है

words.sanskrit: यस्मात् च बृहति बृंहयति च सर्वम्

meaning.en: because it grows and makes all grow
meaning.hi: क्योंकि वह बढ़ता और सबको बढ़ाता है

meaning.en: why is it called the Self

meaning.hi: क्योंकि वह सबको व्याप्त करता है

meaning.en: takes in all and consumes all
meaning.hi: सबको ग्रहण करता और सबको खाता है

meaning.en: why is he called the Great Lord
because he is lord of the great
meaning.hi: क्योंकि वह महान का ईश है

meaning.en: by the sound of the word and by his own power
to Atri, practising hard austerity, desiring a son
meaning.hi: कठिन तप करते, पुत्र चाहते अत्रि को

meaning.en: the radiant one gave his very self
meaning.hi: ज्योतिर्मय ने अपने आप को ही दिया
अनसूया में अत्रि का पुत्र हुआ

words.sanskrit: यः अस्य निरुक्तानि वेद सः सर्वं वेद

meaning.en: whoever knows these meanings knows all
meaning.hi: जो इसके निरुक्त जानता है वह सब जानता है

words.sanskrit: सः अहम् इति सः ब्रह्मवित् भवति

meaning.en: thinking 'I am he', he becomes a knower of Brahman
meaning.hi: 'मैं वह हूँ' भाव से वह ब्रह्मवित् होता है
नीलम जैसी आभा वाले प्रभु को

meaning.en: the God delighting in his own maya
meaning.hi: अपनी माया में रमे देव को

meaning.en: the one who has cast off all, clothed by the sky
with all limbs smeared with ash

meaning.hi: चार भुजाओं वाले, सुंदर अंगों वाले

meaning.en: the treasury of knowledge and yoga
meaning.hi: ज्ञान और योग के भंडार को

meaning.en: teacher of the world, dear to yogis

meaning.hi: भक्तों पर करुणा करने वाले को

meaning.en: witness of all, served by the perfected
meaning.hi: सबके साक्षी, सिद्धों से सेवित को
जो इस तरह लगातार ध्यान करे

meaning.en: on the eternal God of gods
he is freed from all sins
meaning.hi: वह सब पापों से मुक्त है
